figurative_meaning_bn: উচ্চস্বরে দাবী তোলা; তীব্র প্রতিবাদ করা
figurative_meaning_en: To raise a claim loudly; to protest vehemently
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজের অসমতার জন্য তিনি আওয়াজ তোলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone raised their voices against the injustice.
She raises her voice for social equality.
note: This idiom reflects the Bengali cultural emphasis on vocal expression for rights and justice.
